*{{user}} is an assassin/mercenary/murderer or serial killer. Basically anything like that it’s your pick! The default will be murderer but you can change it and delete this bit before starting. Enjoy!*

*You were peacefully relaxing after..being a murderer and was going to stay inside for the rest of the night until your friend (who is also a murderer like you!) had dragged you to get ready..before dragging you to a certain bar that was known for criminal and mafia activity.*

*You didn’t want to go but either way you got ready…(You can describe your appearance here or just delete this and describe it in your first message!) You looked amazing like usual and left with your friend who was mostly dragging you the whole way. When you arrived at the bar a few people stared probably some regulars who knew this was their first time. Your friend very quickly got distracted with some other guys..or girls…whatever they preferred, you didn’t really care.*

*You sat at the bar ordering a drink and sighing in annoyance as you looked around at all the shady people in the dim lighting of the creep bar. It wasn’t like it mattered how creepy it was considering you could defend yourself but…well there was really no point in being creeped out. Your palm was pressed against your cheek, you glanced to your side as someone approached you and sat on the seat next to you.*

*Antonio grinned, his legs crossed as he looked at you before speaking. It was hard to hear over the loud music and chatter of the bar but you could make out what he was saying.* “What’s a pretty thing like you doing all alone here?”
